_about: Soundcore command table. A command is two bytes, written as hex. source: openscq30 (read from OpenSCQ30's source) or soundcore_app (seen in a recording of the official app, or read in its code, Soundcore 3.3.0's `Cmm2CmdData`: the note says which). confirmed lists the models a recording in data/soundcore/reports confirms it on. private marks bodies that can carry personal data (addresses, names, serial numbers, sleep times or alarms): a recording from the official app leaves them out. capture_max_bytes bounds a newly identified control's published body; larger replies get a short preview. Recording-only entries add no probes or settings. See docs/soundcore/PROTOCOL.md.

frame.checksum: The sum of every byte before it, modulo 256.
frame.vendor_service_uuid_note: The last five hex digits vary. On the A3116 and A3936 they are b and the model number.

Reads usage counters. PairFree does not use it. On the A6611 the reply starts with the model, the serial number and the Bluetooth address.

The earbuds send the sound modes after a change.
Body: the sound modes block, 6 bytes on the A3936; byte 0: 0 noise cancelling, 1 transparency, 2 normal.

Which noise modes the noise-control touch action cycles through. Body: 1 noise cancelling + 2 transparency + 4 normal; on models with a TWS cycle, the low four bits with both earbuds in, the high four with one.
With two devices on, the earbuds send one entry per known device unasked, 42 bytes each on the A3936. Each holds a device's address and name: never put them in a report.
Two devices at once. Body: 1 on, 0 off.

The ear tip fit test (Soundcore 2.9.9, the A3951 family's manager: A3931, A3935, A3951). Request with no body; the reply's body is the left earbud's code, the right's, then pressure and over and under values (24 bytes or more): a code of 0 or 1 is a good fit. 2.9.9 sends it and only logs the result on these models; PairFree shows it on the shared fit test screen. Not confirmed on hardware.
Body: 1 on, 0 off. Soundcore 3.3.0 `Cmm2CmdData` 01 81 (`setMoreWearDetectionCallback`).
Body: 1 on, 0 off. Soundcore 3.3.0 01 84 (`setMoreSideToneCallback`).
Body: 1 on, 0 off. Soundcore 3.3.0 01 8C (`setInEarToneCallback`; the A3953's in-ear beep).

The parametric equalizer of the models whose command service takes `c6()` (Soundcore 5.0.35 `CmmBtCmdService.m6`): the position (u16), the HearID switch, state and time (u32), the filter count and 13 bytes a filter (type, then gain, Hz and Q as float32). Bodies are built by SoundcoreNormalizedEqualizer.

The Life NC (A3201)'s request for its whole state, which it answers with the level, the vibration switch, the custom button function, the volume limit's switch and value, the firmware, the serial and the name. Soundcore 5.0.35 `A3201CmdConstants`.
Body: 1 on, 0 off. Soundcore 5.0.35 `A3201DeviceManager.B0` (the Life NC's vibration).
Body: 1 on, 0 off. Soundcore 5.0.35 `A3201CmdConstants.v` (the Life NC's volume limit).
Body: the limit, 0 to 16. Soundcore 5.0.35 `A3201DeviceManager.A0`.
Body: 1 on, 0 off. Soundcore 3.3.0 02 84 (`setDeviceBassUpCallback`).
Body: switch, effect, sound mode (one byte each). Soundcore 3.3.0 10 81 (`setSpatialAudioStatusCallback`; the A3953's spatial audio).
Body: 1 on, 0 off. Soundcore 3.3.0 10 82 (`setLowBatteryAlertSwitchCallback`).
Body: 1 on, 0 off. Soundcore 3.3.0 10 83 (`setAmbientSoundPromptSwitchCallback`).
Body: 1 on, 0 off. Soundcore 3.3.0 10 86 (`setLeakySwitchCallback`).

Soundcore 5.0.35 `CmmBtCmdService.z6`, on the models whose service says `d6` (D1102, D1105, D1203, D1204, D1206, D1406, D1407): body is the prompt's bit in state record 26 (0 touch tone, 1 low battery, 2 power off, 3 in-ear, 4 connect, 5 mode change, 6 ambient sound) and 1 on or 0 off.

Soundcore 5.0.35 `CmmBtCmdService.h5` (`U5`, `d6` models): body is the switch's bit in state record 27 (1 game mode, 2 LDAC, 3 two devices on D1203 and D1204, 8 wear detection, 14 easy chat, 29 sound field rendering, 56 incoming call noise reduction, 57 voice input enhancement) and 1 on or 0 off.
Body: 1 on, 0 off (`CmmBtCmdService.h3`; the indexed models send `41 87 04` instead).
Body: one byte, 100 plus the balance from -6 (left) to 6 (right) (`CmmBtCmdService.W0`, `VolumeBalanceDetailItemBinder`; the AeroClip 2 pair).

The Space 2 Pro pair's multi-function button held (`CmmBtCmdService.Y4`): body 00, 01 and the action in the low nibble (5 the phone's voice assistant, 13 nap mode, 15 nothing). State record 73 holds it as 0, 3 and 5.

Body: side, press, the action with both earbuds in and with one (`CmmBtCmdService.p4`, the indexed models). The Space 2 Pro pair's noise button pressed twice: 00 00, 255 nothing or 7 powerful bass, 00; state record 72, second byte.
The voice prompt when the sound mode changes on the Space One, Space One Pro, Space Q45 and Space 2 (`CmmBtCmdService.R4`, their prompt screens; OpenSCQ30 sends the same). Body: 1 on, 0 off.

The battery level announced when the headphones are switched on (`CmmBtCmdService.n4`; the Space One, Space Q45 and Space 2). Body: 1 on, 0 off. OpenSCQ30 calls it the low battery prompt. PairFree 0.18.0 and earlier sent the Q45 10 82, which its app does not.

The high volume limit: body 1 on or 0 off, then the limit in dB, 75 to 100 (`CmmBtCmdService.o2`; the hearing protection screens). The Liberty 4 Pro's write has a third byte. State field limit_high_volume: switch, dB, the app's reading interval.
Disconnects a paired device: its six address bytes (`CmmBtCmdService.m1`; OpenSCQ30 sends the same).
Connects a paired device: its six address bytes (`CmmBtCmdService.S3`; OpenSCQ30 sends the same).
Removes a device from the earbuds' list: its six address bytes (`CmmBtCmdService.Z3`; OpenSCQ30 sends the same). PairFree asks first.
No body: the earbuds let another device pair (`CmmBtCmdService.s1`, `makeDeviceSearchedStatusCallback`).
The voice prompts' language on the Space Q45 and Liberty 3 Pro: 0 English, 1 Chinese (`CmmBtCmdService.r5`).
The Frames' Manual Shutdown (lab functions): 1 lets a held logo area turn them off, 0 not (`CmmBtCmdService.Y1`).
The Frames' OpenSurround: 1 on or 0 off, then the level 0 to 4 (`CmmBtCmdService.v4`).
The Frames' voice commands: 1 on or 0 off, then the language as reported (`CmmBtCmdService.x1`).
The Frames' Enhanced Volume: 1 on, 0 off (`CmmBtCmdService.g1`).
The VR P10's light: the colour 0 to 4, then the mode 0 breathing, 1 on, 2 battery saving (`CmmBtCmdService.y4`, `A3850LightVM`).
The wear detection calibration of the Space headphones: body 0 for the step on a table, 1 for the step worn (`CmmBtCmdService.h0`). The reply's second and third bytes read 1 when the step passed.

The personal noise cancelling test (Liberty 3 Pro, Liberty 4 NC): 1 start or 0 cancel, the time in seconds (high byte first), the room's noise in dB or 255 for none (`CmmBtCmdService.V2`). The reply's first byte is the result's index, 255 none.
No body: removes the personal noise cancelling (`CmmBtCmdService.B0`).
The VR P10's USB dongles: a count, then 33 bytes each (name 20, connected 1, type 1, firmware 5, address 6). `CmmBtCmdService.j1`.
No body; the reply is 1 when the dongle's low power mode is on (`CmmBtCmdService.X1`).
What the connected dongle is plugged into: 0 Oculus, 1 PS4/5, 2 PC, 3 Switch, 4 phone, 5 other (`CmmBtCmdService.u4`, `A3850DongleSelectM`).
No body: disconnects the dongle (`CmmBtCmdService.k2`).
Forgets a dongle: its six address bytes (`CmmBtCmdService.v5`). PairFree asks first.
Connects a dongle: its six address bytes (`CmmBtCmdService.z0`).
The dongle's low power mode: 1 on, 0 off (`CmmBtCmdService.setDongleLPWRSwitch`).
Body: one byte, the level. Soundcore 3.3.0 04 85 (`setCustomPressSensitivityCallback`; the A3953's press sensitivity screen).
Body: 1 on, 0 off. Soundcore 3.3.0 01 AA (`setSmartPlaySwitchCallback`; the Sleep A10 pauses the sound once asleep).
Body: 1 on, 0 off. Soundcore 3.3.0 01 AC (`setAdaptiveNoiseSwitchCallback`; the Sleep A10).
Body: 1 on, 0 off. Soundcore 3.3.0 01 A1 (`setSuperHearingCallback`; the VR P10).
Body: 1 on, 0 off. Soundcore 3.3.0 01 A2 (`setCallMixCallback`; the VR P10).
Body: 1 on, 0 off. Soundcore 3.3.0 01 A3 (`setMicrophoneCallback`; the VR P10).

Find earbuds: three bytes, left, right and the case (1 beeps, 0 stops). Soundcore 5.0.35 `CmmBtCmdService.r0`; the app sends 0 0 0 when its screen closes. The earbuds report the same three under 01 09.
